title: sys_comment / sys_attachment reads with any filter or sort fail on hosted (Turso/libSQL) environments: the parent-record read gate builds an OR tree deeper than SQLite's 100-level limit
body:
repo:cloud#2 · os-zhuang · session_0123kRqqdpAJWYMgsgdAJX4G

Filing gate ①: a reproduced product defect, user-visible, with a named producer. Reach: hosted environments, public data API. Reproduced on staging (three environments) and seen once on production.

Reader: objectstack `domain:services` (plugin-audit / plugin-security parent-record read gate), the seat that landed #24060. Suggested p1, because comments and attachments look lost on every hosted record page. Triage sets the final priority.

Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack "Expression tree is too large"` gives 0 hits. `ReadableIds depth` gives 12 hits, all closed or seat posts. The nearest is #24060 (closed by PR #24177, `62c4441efd`), which narrowed the gate to one branch per object the read NAMES. This defect is the case that narrowing does not reach. #24932 (closed) is a different limit (too many SQL variables).

Business reason: on every hosted environment the record detail page's discussion shows 「暂无评论」 and the attachments tab count is empty. Comments and files a user wrote look lost, and the failure is silent, visible only in devtools. Producer: objectstack-ai/cloud#3485 (p1).

## Reproduced (cloud#3485, staging `os-2ph4c1` with HotCRM 6.0.0, browser session)
- `GET /api/v1/data/sys_comment?top=5` returns 200, and so does `sys_attachment?top=5`.
- Any sort or filter returns 500 `DATABASE_ERROR`, for example:
  - `sys_comment?top=1&sort=created_at`
  - `sys_comment?filter=["thread_id","=","crm_lead:…"]`
  - `sys_attachment?filter=["and",["parent_object","=","crm_lead"],["parent_id","=","…"]]`
- The same five reads on the control plane (Postgres) return 200.
- The container log line, 23+ occurrences in 48 h on staging and 1 on production v2.7.0, is always the same:
  `[sql-driver] DATABASE_ERROR — the backend refused a read on 'sys_comment' (SQLITE_UNKNOWN) … SQLite error: Expression tree is too large (maximum depth 100)`
- The behaviour is the same on cloud pins `6cbdef1e` and `c88467d4`.

## Reading (to be confirmed by the reader)
The parent-record read gate ORs one subquery branch per registered parent object. A bare environment has 78 parents, HotCRM adds more, and a filter or sort adds a few levels. The tenant database (Turso / libSQL) refuses an expression tree deeper than 100. Local SQLite's default limit is 1000, which is why a fresh local stack answers 200. #24060 narrowed the gate only when the read names its parent objects. A `thread_id` filter (`crm_lead:…`) or a sort does not name them through the shape the narrowing reads.

## Acceptance
1. A `sys_comment` / `sys_attachment` read with a filter or sort compiles to an expression tree that does not grow with the number of registered parent objects. Two ways to get there: a balanced or flat `IN` form instead of a left-deep `OR` chain, or narrowing on `thread_id` / `parent_object` the way #24177 narrows on named objects.
2. A regression test runs with SQLite's expression depth lowered to 100 (`SQLITE_LIMIT_EXPR_DEPTH`), with 120 or more registered parent objects and the filtered reads above, and passes.
3. The rows and totals a reader sees are unchanged: the gate still withholds rows on unreadable parents.

## Related
objectstack-ai/cloud#3485, #24060, #24177, #24932
